A1.scenario: Short recordings split into restart-Type rounds and continuous-Type rounds with sub-1s capsule reopen latency.
A1.expected_user_visible_behavior: Each legal short recording shows a new capsule quickly and does not lose a round silently; short transcript text is evidence-only by default because ambient speech can interfere.
firmware_observables: BLE packet counts and missing/duplicate packet counters
A1.failure_classification: latency, dropped_round, transport, asr, insertion, capsule
artifact_requirements: firmware serial or diag reference when available
